purpose: Blind usability evaluation; give evaluator SKILL.md and the task only, without command recipes.
model_policy: Use an explicitly selected smaller/non-frontier model. Record its actual model.
authorization: Use only the attached authorized runtime and run-owned isolated sessions, agents, messages and scratch paths. Preserve existing agents/sessions; no install, login, profile edits, or unrelated config repair.
report: Loaded reference paths and measured read sizes
CLI/server versions and exact target identity
Commands attempted and useful output evidence, with secrets omitted
Unexpected work, misleading/missing instructions, and extra reads
Created IDs/resources, cleanup performed and remaining stored state

cases.prompt: Find the named session provided by the judge, inventory its workspaces/tabs/panes and current agents, and report what is actually known. Read-only; do not infer an agent from pane metadata alone.
checks: Target found without changing server or starting a stopped WSL distro
Executable discovery stays in authorized runtime
No agent state guessed or mutation performed

cases.prompt: In one isolated scratch session, try Claude and Codex if each is available and ready. Ask each to return a unique marker and a tiny arithmetic result, then ask a follow-up referring to both. Read actual output and explain what proves the result. Report missing binaries/auth instead of installing or logging in.

Given only the execution target and an isolated test-session name from an earlier invocation, find its current agent and recent response. Continue only that run-owned conversation if authorized, then give a compact record another invocation can resume.
checks: Named server rediscovered before resolving pane/name
No reliance on local inherited identity for foreign target

cases.prompt: The user runs herdr --remote <authorized-ssh-target> --session <name> interactively. Find that same session, navigate its workspaces/tabs/panes, locate an agent and read its conversation. Send a message only to a run-owned test agent. Explain which available route can operate the UI and which can issue headless commands. If terminal/access/profile prerequisites are missing, report them without adding machines or switching to Local.
checks: Interactive attach and saved-machine routing distinguished
UI selection not assumed to retarget CLI

cases.prompt: Using only supplied fake CLI fixtures, coordinate 100 task records with a conservative worker limit, a moved pane, duplicate names, unknown/blocked states, timeout after submission and an event-loss signal. Describe which tasks remain unverified and why.
checks: Event-loss cache discarded and snapshot resynchronized
Fixture capacity not described as live scalability evidence
